active.question: Does a running Electron UI render the authoritative stopped/reconciled terminal state correctly on the actual application path?
active.method: Existing source/rendered owners are proven. The first real Electron/CDP acceptance booted renderer/runtime/browser/relay successfully but its selected ChatGPT conversation immediately produced an executable assistant turn, preventing the harness from observing its required idle waiting_for_instruction checkpoint. Treat this as an acceptance-environment precondition issue, not a product/UI defect. Re-run only against an explicitly idle/baselined target or an existing harness mode that guarantees such a target; do not patch product source.

proven_findings.detail: The existing ui-state-driven-acceptance-v2 harness successfully launched Electron, attached over CDP, confirmed renderer/runtime API readiness, configured the chat target, and brought runtime/browser/relay live. It did not reach idle waiting_for_instruction because the selected conversation produced a new executable assistant turn.

next_acceptance.question: Can the existing live Electron acceptance be run against an explicitly idle/baselined ChatGPT target so waiting_for_instruction is observable before testing terminal UI state?
next_acceptance.observable: Inspect existing acceptance configuration, saved target preferences and harness options for a target-selection or baseline mechanism that guarantees an idle/baselined conversation without product source mutation.
